turns.patient_response: I’ve been struggling with these repetitive behaviors that I feel like I have to do, even when I know they don’t really make sense. Things like having to clean or check things over and over are taking up a lot of my time and making it hard to get through my day.

symptom_reasoning.S066: The patient describes repetitive behaviors (cleaning and checking) that they feel compelled to perform despite recognizing they are not logical and that they interfere with daily functioning, consistent with compulsions.
